messages:
Alex R: Quick ask — my flight got rebooked, I can't cover Sat 06:00-14:00. I'm reachable for escalations but can't actively triage. Anyone able to pick up a partial shift? :airplane:
Nina (eng-oncall): @Alex R I can take 06:00-10:00. I can handle initial triage and paging during that window. :raised_hands:
Sam T: I can take 10:00-14:00 if needed. One caveat: I have a lunch call 12:00-12:45 but will be reachable by phone/text only. OK?
Alex R: Thanks both — FYI there's a model rollout scheduled Sat ~09:00 (infra ticket #2245) that could spike alerts. If you're on 06-10, please watch the rollout logs and be ready to pause canary if error rate >1%.
Marta G: I can swap into 09:30-14:00 instead of Sam if that helps — I can overlap with Nina 09:30-10:00 for handoff.
Sam T: If Marta can take 09:30-14:00 I can do 06:00-09:30. Not ideal but doable. Otherwise I'm fine with 10-14 as planned.
Nina (eng-oncall): I'll update the calendar once we confirm. Alex — can you paste the quick runbook commands for pausing rollout and pager steps?
Alex R: Runbook snippets:
```
# Pause rollout
curl -X POST https://deploy.redwood.internal/api/rollouts/2245/pause -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
# Trigger pager escalation
pagerduty trigger --service oncall-team --summary "prod model errors"
```
Primary escalation: @oncall-eng, then @eng-lead. Also watch model QPS and error_rate graphs (threshold = 1%).
oncall-bot: Calendar updated: Alex R removed from Sat 06:00-14:00; Nina assigned 06:00-10:00; Marta assigned 09:30-14:00. Reminders sent to participants.
Alex R: Appreciate it — I left quick notes in ticket #2245: watchdog thresholds, common false positives, and grafana links https://grafana.redwood/prod/model-ops. Happy to do a 10–15m voice handoff Fri 18:00 if anyone wants to sync.
Marta G: I'll shadow @Nina 09:30-10:00 and then take over. :white_check_mark: Everyone ok with this plan?
Sam T: Sounds good to me. I'll handle any early-morning pings until Nina is on.
Nina (eng-oncall): :thumbsup: Thanks — I'll add one extra check on batching infra between 08:30-09:15 since cache warmup sometimes surfaces alerts during rollout.
